scientific_integrity: Analytic all-parameter proof by first integral; finite independent numerical tests are corroboration only; no external certification.
scientific_limitations: Two symmetric agents, exponential influence, logistic tie reinforcement, degree normalization with unit self-weights; not a general-network theorem. Equivalence with unindexed prior results remains a priority risk.
title: A sharp relationship-strength separatrix for two-agent coevolving opinions
